laws.guiOnly: Journeys start at homepage/role-landing and complete through visible controls only; no deep links, no direct API/service/DB during the journey (journey-evidence.ts GuiOnlyProof, lines 268-284).
laws.evidence: Every journey — including failures — produces an evidence record; assertions are checked AFTER the journey only (journey-evidence.ts laws, lines 5-16).
laws.noFabrication: UNKNOWN provider state is preserved, never fabricated healthy (journey-evidence.ts:189-204); proof levels must reflect real journaled evidence; competitor performance stays UNKNOWN when unsupported (law §3).
laws.antiOverfitting: Baseline namespace only (3,900 projects); holdout W1-009-H-* untouched until the held-out final (protocol §7); frozen contract byte-identical.

levers.title: Real connector health probing recorded on connector-dependent journeys

groundedIn.whatChanges: the generic driver hardcodes connector state 'unknown' for connectorDependent families; extend it (and the real connector runtime it composes) to perform an actual health probe through the connector-studio surface and record the observed state
ConnectorHealthSnapshot (healthy|degraded|customer-action-required|unknown|down, with evidence refs) is the real health model the probe would surface
ConnectorHealthSurfaceEntry / ConnectorJourneyHealthSummary already define the per-journey health summary the record could carry

componentsMoved.mechanism: connector state 'unknown' (0.3) → 'healthy' (1.0) on connector-dependent families; cohort integration mean 0.411 → 0.722 (+3.1 points at weight 0.1)
second-order: single-tool 0.3·i and specialist-stack 0.85·i couplings lift with integration (+0.7 points cohort mean)

levers.expectedAdoptionMovement: mean score +3.8 (83.9 → ~87.7 on the fully-evidenced cohort); no eligibility change (already 100% under full evidence) — the movement shows in the score distribution and in real degraded-connector scenarios

risks.guiOnly: low — probe must run through the visible connector-studio surface
risks.evidence: low — health snapshots carry evidence refs
risks.noFabrication: HIGH — a hardcoded 'healthy' without a real probe is exactly the fabrication the law forbids; the probe must actually execute

levers.measurementCost: one baseline-namespace campaign re-run per increment

componentsMoved.mechanism: P2→P5 lifts per-record trust 0.55→1.0; P3→P5 lifts 0.75→1.0; cohort trust mean 0.626 → 1.0 (+5.6 points at weight 0.15)

risks.evidence: MEDIUM — proof levels must correspond to real journaled evidence chains, not labels
risks.noFabrication: HIGH — stamping P5 without the underlying journaled proof is fabrication

levers.measurementCost: one campaign re-run; proof-level distribution audited per family

levers.title: Offline-queue survival of evidence through reconnect on more journeys

groundedIn.whatChanges: OfflineObservationQueueEntry / ReconciliationHandoff define the offline queue; extending reliable evidence survival across session reconnects (the INVARIANT on EvidenceState.preservedThroughReconnect)
preservedThroughReconnect is the +0.1 trust bonus flag

componentsMoved.mechanism: +0.1 per record when evidence survives reconnect; generic driver already sets true on pass paths — the lever hardens it under real interruption variants (failure-variants.ts:91)

levers.expectedAdoptionMovement: +0 to +1.5 depending on interruption-variant exposure; primarily a veto-adjacent robustness lever (session-interruption is also a privacy veto trigger)

risks.noFabrication: MEDIUM — the flag must reflect an actual queue survival, asserted by reconciliation

levers.title: Every journey preserves at least one evidence artifact

groundedIn.whatChanges: hasArtifacts bonus (+0.05) applies per record with ≥1 artifact; absent-driver records (discovery-runner.ts:200) carry empty artifacts
buildAbsentRecord emits evidenceArtifacts: [] — the absent path forgoes the bonus by construction

componentsMoved.mechanism: +0.05 per record once ≥1 artifact is journaled; small but uniform

levers.expectedAdoptionMovement: +0.75 cohort mean at full coverage (0.15 × 0.05); +more in combination with L02 (bonus saturates at min(1,·))

risks.noFabrication: MEDIUM — artifacts must be real journal entries

levers.title: Post-journey commerce assertions on every journey family

groundedIn.whatChanges: records with ZERO assertions count as parity 0 — a journey that runs but asserts nothing scores outcomeVsBenchmark 0 for that record
the generic driver emits exactly one 'assert-budget' assertion; family-specific assertion sets (order state, inventory reconciliation, refund evidence) deepen parity coverage
the W1 oracle fields (purchasingList, budget, recourseContract) define what can be asserted post-journey

componentsMoved.mechanism: guarantees ≥1 passing assertion per record so parity tracks real completion rather than assertion absence

levers.expectedAdoptionMovement: 0 under the current all-pass one-assertion baseline (parity already 1.0); protects against parity loss when family-specific drivers land (pairs with L12)

risks.evidence: MEDIUM — assertions are checked AFTER the journey only (checkedAfterJourney literal true); adding assertions cannot gate the journey itself
risks.noFabrication: MEDIUM — assertions must check real post-journey state

levers.title: Authorized incumbent trials upgrading evidence classes (B/C → A)

groundedIn.whatChanges: the evidence-class policy explicitly reserves A for incumbents the campaign actually trialled; the stack defaults are conservative B/C/D
bestIncumbentEvidenceClass takes the best class across the firm stack; class D zeroes parity

componentsMoved.mechanism: no firm currently has best-class D (verified: 0/39 firms), so parity is not gated today; A-class upgrades harden against D-drift when stacks change

levers.expectedAdoptionMovement: 0 on the current cohort (no D-gate fires); eliminates a latent −20-point per-persona cliff

risks.noFabrication: HIGH — upgrading without a trial is a superiority-claim fabrication

levers.title: Navigation wayfinding: fewer dead-ends and wrong-surfaces

groundedIn.whatChanges: BacktrackRecord reasons (dead-end, wrong-surface, …) each cost 0.1 friction
frictionPenaltyFor sums backtrack×0.1 + failed×0.15 + blocked×0.2 + errorRecovery×0.1 + outcome penalty

componentsMoved.mechanism: each avoided backtrack saves 0.1 per-record penalty; at 0.15 weight, saving one backtrack per journey ≈ +1.5 points

levers.expectedAdoptionMovement: 0 on the all-pass generic baseline (no backtracks recorded); material once family-specific drivers exercise real navigation depth (pairs with L12) and in failure-variant exposure

risks.guiOnly: MEDIUM — wayfinding must be improved in the visible navigation graph, not by driver shortcuts
risks.noFabrication: MEDIUM — drivers must not silently drop backtracks (law §2)

INTENT_CONSTRAINT_FIELDS (constraint field descriptors, input kinds) — the intent-canvas form surface where validation friction concentrates

componentsMoved.mechanism: failed (0.15) and blocked (0.2) steps are the heaviest friction penalties; in-form validation guidance prevents failed submissions

levers.expectedAdoptionMovement: 0 on the all-pass baseline; up to +2-3 points under realistic failure-variant exposure (0.15 weight × penalty deltas)

levers.title: Recovery actions that resolve errors inside the journey

groundedIn.whatChanges: each errorRecoveryTrace entry costs 0.1 friction EVEN WHEN RECOVERED; recovery actions (retry, reconnect, requeue-offline, request-approval) exist but still penalize

levers.expectedAdoptionMovement: 0 on the all-pass baseline; +1-2 under failure-variant exposure

risks.guiOnly: MEDIUM — approvals must be actuated through visible controls, never auto-granted

risks.antiOverfitting: MEDIUM — access changes must reflect real product RBAC decisions, not test conveniences; the W2 persona rolePermissions are frozen
